title: ToolRecord
description: Normalized intelligence object representing a tool, SDK, or protocol. Designed for intent-aware retrieval, trust-weighted ranking, and workflow composition — not CRUD.

id.description: Stable slug. Never change after first publication — it is the foreign key target for WorkflowRecord.phases[].tools and all cross-references.

name.description: Display name. May differ from id if tool was rebranded. Historical names live in aliases[].

aliases.description: All previous names and ALL package names that identify this tool in a user repo. Critical for repo-aware matching. e.g. WalletConnect → Reown means aliases includes '@walletconnect/web3modal'.

category.description: Primary ontology category (V2). ONE per tool. Multi-role tools express secondary roles via workflow_positions[] and subcategory, not additional categories. See docs/ONTOLOGY-V2.md for membership tests.

subcategory.description: Subcategory within the primary category. See taxonomy-map.json for valid subcategory values per category. Subcategories are metadata — they do not affect retrieval routing but narrow results within a category query.

description.description: Retrieval-oriented description. Written to answer 'what builder intent does this serve?' Not marketing copy. Max 2 sentences.

ecosystem_fit.description: Per-ecosystem fit assessments. Structured — not a string tag. Required for ecosystem-filtering at retrieval time.

strength.description: dominant=the default choice in this ecosystem. strong=actively used, good fit. limited=possible but suboptimal. none=not used. not-applicable=architectural mismatch.

notes.description: Only populate when strength is non-obvious or requires ecosystem-specific context.

capabilities.description: What this tool does. Use kebab-case verb phrases: 'embedded-wallet-creation', 'webhook-streaming', 'transaction-simulation'. These drive capability-based retrieval — do not use noun phrases.

workflow_positions.description: Roles this tool occupies within a workflow stack. Different from category — category is what it IS, positions are WHERE it sits in an execution pipeline. A tool can have multiple positions.

common_pairings.description: Tools that appear alongside this one in production workflows. Each pairing has relationship context and the workflow situation where it applies.

context.description: When this pairing is appropriate. Not required but strongly preferred.

workflow_ref.description: WorkflowRecord id where this pairing is the canonical pattern.

trust_state.description: Current trust classification per TRUST_MODEL.md. Denormalized copy of TrustSignalRecord.derived_trust_state for retrieval performance.

trust_evidence.description: Specific evidence backing the trust_state. Kept inline on ToolRecord for retrieval co-location. Full signal analysis lives in TrustSignalRecord.

package_identifiers.description: Package manager names for repo-aware detection. Include ALL package names for this tool including historical ones. A user's package.json may reference an old package name.

skill_refs.description: IDs of SkillRecords that provide operational context for this tool.

workflow_refs.description: IDs of WorkflowRecords where this tool appears. Used for reverse lookup: given a tool, find all workflows that use it.

sdk_migration.description: Present when tool is in an active SDK transition. This is a retrieval safety field — tools in migration produce stale recommendations if this is ignored.

to_tool_id.description: ID of the ToolRecord that supersedes this one, if applicable.

scale_guidance.description: How recommendation changes across scales. Do NOT duplicate generic best practices — only populate when this tool behaves differently at different scales.

alternatives.description: Alternatives for the same workflow slot. Encode WHY you would choose each — not just a list.

anti_patterns.description: Known misuse patterns. Critical for repo-audit mode — these are the things to flag when this tool is detected in a repo.

retrieval_tags.description: Supplemental terms for semantic retrieval not captured by structured fields. Keep minimal — if a concept belongs in capabilities or description, put it there instead.

updated_at.description: When this record was last reviewed for accuracy. null = never reviewed. Records older than 90 days should be flagged for review in web3 tooling.
